Title: App Service Performance Degradation - High CPU
SystemDesignKnowledge: ASP.NET Core web application with SQL database backend
InitialSymptoms: Users complaining about slow page loads especially during business hours
SymptomsObserved: High CPU utilization at 90%, slow response times, performance degradation during peak hours
StepsFollowed:

2. Added missing indexes
3. Optimized query patterns

Pitfalls: Don't scale up without investigating query performance first
